units.source_text: “我想，如果你家有财产，现在就应该分到自己手里，

en.t: I think that if your family has property, you ought to have your own share settled in your hands now,

units.source_text: 也许是我多管闲事吧。

en.t: though perhaps I am meddling in what is none of my business.

units.source_text: 不过趁你父亲健在的时候，最好把自己那份先分到手，

en.t: But while your father is still alive, it would be best to receive your share first,

units.source_text: 因为万一有什么事的话，最麻烦的就是财产问题。”

en.t: because if anything should happen, the most troublesome matter will be the property.”

units.source_text: “是啊。”

en.t: “Yes.”

units.source_text: 我并没有特别重视先生的话，

en.t: I did not attach any special importance to Sensei's words,

units.source_text: 我相信在我们家里没有一个人会担心这个，不仅是我，父母也一样。

en.t: and I believed that no one in our family would worry about such a thing, not only I, but my parents as well.

units.source_text: 而且以先生的身份，说出这样的话来，未免也太现实了些，着实令我有些惊讶。

en.t: Besides, for Sensei to say something like that seemed far too practical, and it truly surprised me a little.

units.source_text: 只是出于对长辈的尊敬，才没有说出口。

en.t: I merely kept silent out of respect for an elder.

units.source_text: “我刚才提到了你要早作准备，以避免你父亲去世后的麻烦事，

en.t: “A moment ago I spoke of your making preparations early, so as to avoid trouble after your father's death,

units.source_text: 如果这些话让你不快，请原谅。

en.t: and if those words offended you, please forgive me.

units.source_text: 但是，人总是要死的，

en.t: But people are bound to die,

units.source_text: 无论身体多健康的人，也说不准什么时候就死了。”

en.t: and no matter how healthy someone is, no one can say when he may die.”

units.source_text: 先生的语气流露出少见的痛苦。

en.t: A rare note of pain showed in Sensei's tone.

units.source_text: “我根本没把这些当回事儿。”我辩解道。

en.t: “I did not take any of that seriously at all,” I said in my defense.

units.source_text: “你兄妹几个？”先生问。

en.t: “How many brothers and sisters do you have?” Sensei asked.

units.source_text: 接着先生又问了我们家族的人数，

en.t: Then Sensei asked how many people were in my family,

units.source_text: 有没有亲戚，以及叔叔婶子的情况。

en.t: whether we had relatives, and about the circumstances of my uncle and aunt.

units.source_text: 最后说：

en.t: Finally he said:

units.source_text: “都是好人吗？”

en.t: “Are they all good people?”

units.source_text: “好像没有什么坏人，都是乡下人。”

en.t: “There do not seem to be any especially bad people; they are all country people.”

units.source_text: “乡下人为什么就不坏呢？”

en.t: “Why should country people therefore not be bad?”

units.source_text: 对这一追问，我回答不了，

en.t: I could not answer this further question,

units.source_text: 先生没等我作出回答，就接着说：

en.t: and without waiting for me to reply, Sensei went on:
